scripts.check: npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && mkdir -p test-results && vitest list --no-static-parse --json=test-results/vitest-discovery.json && vitest run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=test-results/vitest.json && node scripts/check-test-execution.mjs vitest test-results/vitest-discovery.json test-results/vitest.json
scripts.test:e2e:inside: npm run build && npm run build:debug && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=test-results/playwright-discovery.json playwright test --list --reporter=json && playwright test && node scripts/check-test-execution.mjs playwright test-results/playwright-discovery.json test-results/playwright.json
scripts.build:debug: node scripts/check-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode debug --outDir dist-debug
scripts.test:coverage:inside: COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --outDir dist-coverage && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 vite build --mode debug --outDir dist-debug-coverage && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=test-results/playwright-coverage-discovery.json playwright test --list --reporter=json && COVERAGE_BROWSER=1 playwright test && node scripts/check-test-execution.mjs playwright test-results/playwright-coverage-discovery.json test-results/playwright-coverage.json
